newsitem.title: USA: Hudson General names Michael Rubin pres.
newsitem.headline: Hudson General names Michael Rubin pres.

text.p: Hudson General Corp said Monday its board had elected Michael Rubin president of the company.
Rubin previously served as executive vice president and chief financial officer of the company and will continue to serve as Hudson's principal financial officer, a statement from the company said.
Jay Langner continues to serve as chairman and chief executive officer, the statement said.

In addition, the company said, Paul Pollack was elected president and Raymond Rieder was elected executive vice president of Hudson General LLC, the corporation's 74-percent owned subsidiary which provides various services at airports throughout the United States and Canada, the statement said.
